note: Free city park RV stop on 6th St in Campo. Directory listings (RV Life, AllStays), not the town, describe ~3 RV-only sites with water and toilets, no hookups, open all year, first-come; realistically 2-3 rigs, and low shade trees mean watching overhead clearance in a tall rig. No page of its own; the Town of Campo is at 719-787-2416. --Claude
summary: No official source for the RV stop: the Baca County Campo page has only the town's contact details (phone 719-787-2416 matches the entry), the county camping page is fair camping only, and Google Maps at the pin shows only the Campo Community Center. The free/3-site/water/no-hookup/year-round/FCFS values all rested on directory listings (RV Life, AllStays) and are cleared, with the facts kept in the note as directory-reported. Overhead-clearance wording kept as a listing caveat; nothing confirms whether a 23-ft motorhome fits.
flags: No live web presence for the campground: no Town of Campo or Baca County page mentions RV camping or overnight use at the city park (the 'website' is a town contact page), and Google Maps has no listing for it (only 'Campo Community Center', 627 Walnut St, 4.6/31 reviews, ~60 m from the pin). Inclusion rests only on RV Life and AllStays. Whether overnight RV use is still allowed needs a call to the Town of Campo (719-787-2416).

Fit unconfirmed: only directory listings describe the ~3 sites ('realistically 2-3 rigs', low trees); no source gives a site length, so 23-ft fit and overhead clearance under 10.5 ft cannot be confirmed.
